exposure: Autologous fat grafting combined with adhesion release surgery
outcome: Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS) scores for color
Presence of adipocyte-like cells in scar tissue
cohort: Thirty-six patients experiencing scar adhesion to the abdominal wall after previous cesarean section.
finding: Autologous fat grafting combined with adhesion release significantly improved the appearance, texture, and depression of abdominal wall scars, as well as reducing pain, pruritus, hardness, fullness, mobility, and improving color, with no severe adverse reactions.
